label: Bible Study
prompt: Then Gideon built an _____ there unto the LORD, and called it Jehovah-shalom: unto this day it is yet in Ophrah of the Abiezrites.
verse: Then Gideon built an altar there unto the LORD, and called it Jehovah-shalom: unto this day it is yet in Ophrah of the Abiezrites.
note: Gideon's altar, named Jehovah-shalom — 'the LORD is peace' — built while Midianites still ruled the land.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Then shall the virgin rejoice in the _____, both young men and old together: for I will turn their mourning into joy, and will comfort them, and make them rejoice from their sorrow.
verse: Then shall the virgin rejoice in the dance, both young men and old together: for I will turn their mourning into joy, and will comfort them, and make them rejoice from their sorrow.
note: After exile: young and old dancing together, mourning turned into joy.

label: Sunday School
prompt: His head and his hairs were white like _____, as white as snow; and his eyes were as a flame of fire;
verse: His head and his hairs were white like wool, as white as snow; and his eyes were as a flame of fire;
note: John's description of Jesus echoes Daniel 7:9: hair white like wool, as white as snow.

label: Deep Water
prompt: That I may know him, and the power of his resurrection, and the fellowship of his _____, being made conformable unto his death;
verse: That I may know him, and the power of his resurrection, and the fellowship of his sufferings, being made conformable unto his death;
note: Paul wants the whole package — resurrection power and shared sufferings — written from a prison cell.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: But let us, who are of the day, be sober, putting on the _____ of faith and love; and for an helmet, the hope of salvation.
verse: But let us, who are of the day, be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love; and for an helmet, the hope of salvation.
note: Paul's shorter armour list: the 'breastplate of faith and love,' and the hope of salvation for a helmet.
